title: Lieu Foh Sun

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
P. O. REC
No. 762/16
Date 20/12/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE.
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

December 20th 1916

Sir,
It is reported that General Yang has received
a telegram from the Premier granting him 21 days
leave. No mention was made of who was to temporarily
take his place. Two of General Yang's staff officers
and three Colonels from Sungkiang were received
by the General yesterday and received instructions
as to their duties during his absence.
Natives of Fukien in Shanghai are proposing
to hold a meeting in the Guild on Soochow Road
to consider what steps should be taken in regard
to the alleged encroaching by the Japanese on
Chinese sovereign rights at Amoy. The date of
the meeting has not yet been fixed.
The shopkeepers along the route have received
instructions from the Chamber of Commerce to fly
their flags at half mast on the 23rd inst the date
of the funeral of the late General Hwang Hsin.
The so-called rebels who are under the leadership
of Lieu roh Sun 廖仲愷 are very much annoyed at
receiving no reply to thr various letters which they
have sent to the C. S.P. and others and at a meeting
of the leaders yesterday it was proposed that a day
be fixed on which they will go en masse to General
Li Tsing Woo's house and refuse to leave until
their demands are granted. Should the police
interfere they will not resist arrest. No date
has been fixed so far for the visit.

Your Obedient Servant,

mmmmmustins
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

刑事侦缉处
警务处收件
编号 762/16
日期 1916年12月20日
上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处
（侦探科）

1916年12月20日

先生：

据报，杨将军已收到总理发来的电报，批准其休假二十一天。电文中未提及由谁暂时接替其职务。昨日，杨将军的两名参谋军官及三名来自松江的上校晋见将军，并接受了关于在其缺席期间职责的指示。

在沪福建籍人士提议在苏州路的会馆举行会议，商讨针对日本人在厦门 allegedly 侵犯中国主权一事应采取何种步骤。会议日期尚未确定。

沿途商户已接到商会指令，要求于本月23日降半旗致哀，该日为已故黄兴将军的葬礼之日。

所谓在廖仲愷领导下的反叛者，因向中央巡捕房及其他方面发出的多封信件均未获回复而感到极为恼怒。在昨日举行的首领会议上，有人提议选定一日，集体前往李经宇将军寓所，并在诉求得到满足前拒绝离开。若警方介入，他们将不抗拒逮捕。截至目前，尚未确定拜访的具体日期。

您顺从的仆人，

mmmmmustins
首席侦探督察长

警察总监上尉
